items.source: Causes PageImpl instances to be wrapped into PagedModel instances before rendering them as JSON to make sure the representation stays stable even if PageImpl is changed.
items.translation: 将 PageImpl 实例包装为 PagedModel 实例，以便在将其渲染为 JSON 之前确保即使 PageImpl 发生变化，其表示形式也能保持稳定。

items.source: PageImpl instances will be rendered as is (discouraged, as there's no guarantee on the stability of the serialization result as we might need to change the type's API for unrelated reasons).
items.translation: `PageImpl` 实例将按原样渲染（不推荐，因为无法保证序列化结果的稳定性，因为我们可能因无关原因需要更改该类型的 API）。
